thread:
Marta: Heads-up — proposing route_profile_v2 for console telemetry. separates route attrs into a compact table so console queries don't scan huge envelopes. need to sync backfill, quota calc, and dashboard parity.
Ken: curious whether we do dual-write or adapter read-time translation. leaning adapter to avoid migration windows but worried about perf.
Sam: adapter is safer for rollouts, but dual-write gives cleaner slow path removal. what's our SLA for console p99 on route lookups?
Marta: p99 target is 50ms for single-route fetch in console flows. adapter adds lookup and join cost; can we pre-warm cache?
Leah: cache helps but invalidation gets hairy for route edits. also dashboards need aggregate metrics (route counts, quotas) that currently come from envelopes. do we replicate aggregates into v2?
Prateek: proposal: 3-step plan — 1) write-only v2 (dual-write) + read from v1 (no change) 2) read adapter that prefers v2 when available, fallback to v1 3) backfill to v2 and flip reads. minimizes UI regression.
Ken: dual-write first means all producers must be updated. how many producers touch envelope route attrs? ingestion + async enrich + backfills — nontrivial.
Sam: can do a phased producer rollout: ingest-api + shim, then enrich jobs, then archive backfill. We should still include a feature flag to gate v2 writes.
Leah: dashboard parity risk: some ad-hoc SQL queries in Grafana rely on JSON envelope shapes. we'll need view-layer compatibility or a thin migration shim in the analytics DB.
Marta: agree. want to avoid changing dozens of dashboard queries in one go. What about creating a compatibility view: route_profile_v1_view that unions v2->v1 shapes?
Prateek: that works but may be slow for large joins. alternative: materialized view refreshed incrementally by CDC. tradeoff is complexity vs query speed.
Ken: CDC-based materialized view seems good for dashboard read performance. Can we use Debezium pipeline we already have?
Sam: we do have Debezium for some tables; hooking it up to populate route_profile_mv is doable. need ops runbook for rebuilds.
Leah: telemetry retention considerations: if route_profile_v2 stores denormalized attrs, size will grow. we need storage estimates and compaction plan.
Marta: rough numbers: current envelope attr storage ~ 120B per event, route attr subset ~ 40B. at 1M events/day that's ~40MB/day for v2 attr records. cheap but backfill might spike IO.
Ken: backfill IO spike is the main risk to console SLA. propose rate-limited backfill with topology-aware windows (low-traffic regions overnight).
Prateek: agree; implement backfill worker that respects cluster load and target throughput. include kill-switch if p99 > 80ms.
Leah: UI rollouts: console should show "data lagging" banner if v2 parity not met. we need a UX signal tied to the migration state.
Marta: good idea. we can expose migration status via /internal/migration-status route and Console shows banner when status != ready.
Sam: for quota calc: quotas depend on route attributes and derived buckets. if we switch to v2, we must ensure quota engine reads canonical source. Which side is canonical during rollout?
Prateek: canonical stays v1 until we flip reads. quota engine can use adapter that reads v2 first; but during the transition we must reconcile counters to avoid double counting.
Ken: reconciliation plan: shadow counters for a week, compute diffs, run a reconcile job that updates quota state if drift > threshold. document steps.
Leah: tests — need end-to-end smoke: console fetch, dashboard queries, quota check, on a staging dataset. Also run canary with 5% of tenants.
Marta: agree. checklist: 1) dual-write flag + producer updates 2) adapter in read layer 3) CDC materialized view for dashboards 4) backfill workers + rate limit 5) reconcile job 6) migration-status endpoint 7) canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%
Sam: I'll draft the PRs for adapter and backfill workers. estimate 2 sprint cycle.
Ken: I'll own producer changes and feature flag rollout. need coordination with infra for Debezium wiring.
Prateek: I'll own reconciliation and migration-status endpoint. Leah can you sketch banner copy and monitoring signals we need?
Leah: will do. banner text: "Console metrics are being migrated — some data may be delayed. Learn more: <internal link>". Monitoring: p99 route lookup, backfill throughput, CDC lag, v2 row count.
Marta: deploy-bot: can you create a tracking epic and a canary env tag?
deploy-bot: Created epic INF-2134 "route_profile_v2 migration" and added canary tag "routeprofile-v2-canary".
Ken: thanks. one more thought — we should version the route_profile schema with minor version in metadata so small field additions don't require whole migration.
Prateek: add a schema_version column and document compatibility rules.
Marta: ok, action items in thread. We'll sync tomorrow 10am to finalize backfill windows. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
